text:
sylvie: FYI planning to add a Condition to the `snapshot-archiver` role so only principals tagged `department=storage` can assume it. This will touch DB snapshot uploads and S3 snapshot-agent restores. Need quick preflight and a short canary.
bryan: Important: cross-account restore flows use an ephemeral `tenant-restore` principal that doesn't carry our internal tags. That Condition will block them unless we add an allowlist.
sylvie: Good call. Policy delta (only the block changing):
```json
- { "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/snapshot-archiver" }
+ { "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/snapshot-archiver", "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "aws:PrincipalTag/department": "storage" } } }
```
kevin: Two failure modes to watch: 1) AssumeRoleDenied for cross-account restores, 2) KMS Decrypt AccessDenied if grants aren't pre-seeded for the new principal path. We've seen mode (2) during KMS key rotations.
sec-bot: Suggested canary: 20m window, 3 test restores (local, cross-account, cross-region), pre-create temporary KMS grant for the `tenant-restore` role, and a short allowlist for two known external ARNs. Abort if >1 failure or any Decrypt AccessDenied.
bryan: Command to pre-create grant (example):
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/tenant-restore --operations Decrypt --name "canary-tenant-restore"
```
sylvie: Detection queries: CloudTrail lookup for AssumeRole errors and KMS Decrypt AccessDenied. Simple CloudWatch metric filters to page oncount > 0 in 10m.
kevin: Also run an integrity check after restore (checksum vs source) — not just success flag. If checksum mismatch, treat as failure and rollback.
pagerduty: I'll create the oncall rota for the window and attach CHG-20260305-99. Notify 15m prior.
sylvie: I'll add the two external ARNs to a short allowlist and push the change into staging first at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. Kevin + Bryan will own the smoke tests and logs. Post results here after staging.
